sources.title: GitHub - mkorun/aiprov: Interactive TUI for writing IPTC/XMP provenance ...
sources.snippet: aiprov Interactive TUI for writing IPTC/XMP provenance metadata to AI-generated images. Writes machine-readable XMP fields — including the IPTC DigitalSourceType value for generative AI media — directly into a source image (PNG, JPEG, TIFF; also WebP and AVIF/HEIF when used as source).
